## Publication Information

**Date:** 1889

**Imprint:** <i>MP</i> (Christmas 1889)

**Notes:** The story was ascribed by CMY to 'Miss Benson' the daughter of the Archbishop.  This probably means [Margaret Benson](../people/person_1858.qmd) rather than [Mary Eleanor Benson](../people/person_141.qmd).
